title: Immunohistochemistry and High Resolution Microscopy of Human Gastric Enteroendocrine Cells
author: Josiane Fakhry

steps.title: Tissue Fixation and Initial Washing
steps.instruction: Fix the collected stomach regions and perform initial washing steps.

substeps.instruction: Place tissue in cold fixative (2% formaldehyde plus 0.2% picric acid in 0.1 M sodium phosphate buffer, pH 7.0) overnight at 4 °C.
Wash tissues three times (10 min each) with dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO).
Wash tissues three times (10 min each) with PBS.
Transfer tissue samples to PBS-azide.

steps.title: Tissue Embedding and Freezing
steps.instruction: Prepare the tissue for sectioning using a sucrose-OCT mixture.

substeps.instruction: Place tissue samples in a mixture of 50% PBS-sucrose-azide and 50% OCT (Tissue Tek) for 24 h.
Trim the tissue.
Embed in 100% OCT.
Freeze in isopentane cooled with liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Sectioning and Blocking
steps.instruction: Cut tissue sections and block non-specific binding.

substeps.instruction: Cut sections to a thickness of 12 μm onto microscope slides (SuperFrost Plus).
Allow sections to dry at room temperature for 1 h.
Incubate with 10% normal horse serum plus 1% Triton X-100 in PBS for 30 min.

steps.title: Primary and Secondary Antibody Staining
steps.instruction: Perform immunohistochemical staining using primary and secondary antibodies.

substeps.instruction: Apply mixtures of primary antibodies to the sections and incubate at 4 °C overnight.
Wash the tissue three times in PBS.
Incubate with appropriate Alexa Fluor dye-labelled secondary antibodies for 1 h at room temperature.

steps.title: Fluorescence Quenching and Nuclear Staining
steps.instruction: Reduce background fluorescence and stain cell nuclei.

substeps.instruction: Wash tissue with PBS for 5 min.
Incubate with quenching buffer (5 mM CuSO4, 50 mM ammonium acetate, pH 5) for 30 min at room temperature.
Wash preparations three times with PBS for 10 min.
Wash preparations twice with distilled water for 5 min.
Incubate for 5 min with bisbenzimide (blue), diluted 10 μg/mL in dH2O, to stain nuclei.
Wash sections three times with distilled water.

steps.title: Mounting
steps.instruction: Mount the stained sections for microscopy.

substeps.instruction: Mount sections using non-fluorescent mounting medium (Dako).

steps.title: Antibody Specificity Testing (Absorption Test)
steps.instruction: Verify the specificity of ghrelin antibodies using a peptide absorption test.

substeps.instruction: Equilibrate diluted anti-ghrelin antibodies with human ghrelin peptide (100 nM to 100 μM) for 24 h at 4 °C.
Use the equilibrated antibodies for staining tissue sections following the standard protocol.

steps.title: Imaging and Analysis
steps.instruction: Examine and quantify the immunoreactive cells using high-resolution microscopy and software.

substeps.instruction: Image slides using an Axio Imager Z1 microscope and a LSM 800 confocal microscope with Airyscan super-resolution analysis.
Perform cell counts using tile scans with a × 10 objective; export scans to ImageJ software.
Quantify immunoreactive cells by counting 100–500 cells in sections from each part of the stomach across tissues from three patients.
Perform high-resolution analysis using × 40 and × 63 objectives and export images to CorelDraw.
Analyze 3D stacks using Imaris program 8.4.1 with image rendering.
Analyze ghrelin cell clumping in three pieces of fundus from three patients using the Delaunay triangulation protocol in ImageJ by manually circling cells in the region of interest.
